app.name: TraceRoutine
app.promise: Any activity. Your real frequency. No guilt.

today.freeDayBody: Nothing due today. We don't invent tasks.
today.hint: Tap the square to mark it · long-press for the minimum · swipe left to skip
today.skippedToday: Skipped today · tap the square to undo
today.thisWeek: {done} of {times} this week · you choose when
today.emptyTitle: Tap + to create your first activity

freq.neverPaid: Your real frequency — never a paid feature

anchor.title: If you miss a day
anchor.calendarBody: Due on the 1st, {b}, {c}… Miss the {b} and the next is still the {c}. For medication and treatments.
anchor.relativeBody: Miss the {b}, do it on the {d}, and the next is the {e}. For training and plants.
anchor.cycleCalendarBody: Every day is a step, done or not. The calendar rules.
anchor.cycleRelativeBody: The cycle advances when you complete the step. Miss Legs and tomorrow is still Legs.

editor.name: Name
editor.namePlaceholder: e.g. Train, Read, Water the plants
editor.minimalHelp: For bad days. Counts as done and doesn't break your consistency.
editor.previewFlex: About {n} times in {month}, you pick the days.
editor.endsHelp: Leave Ends empty if it's open-ended. Useful for X-day treatments.
editor.reminderHelp: At most one per activity, grouped into a morning summary.
editor.created: Activity created — it's already in your grid
editor.errCycle: The cycle needs at least one step that isn't rest.
editor.errEnd: The end date can't be before the start.

month.overallHelp: over the days that were due
month.tapHelp: Tap a cell to change it: done → minimum → skipped → empty.

stats.title: Your consistency
stats.monthHelp: Completion over scheduled days — the minimum counts, off days never hurt you.
stats.tooEarly: Too early to tell. A week of logs and your numbers will appear.

settings.title: Settings
settings.morningSummaryHelp: One notification with what's due today
settings.localData: Your data lives on your device
settings.proBody: Unlimited activities, grid widget, advanced stats, templates and month sharing. Frequencies are never paid.
settings.freeLimit: Free: up to {limit} active activities — {left} left
settings.notifyMe: Let me know when it's ready

onboarding.step1Body: Train every other day. Physio Monday, Wednesday and Friday. Read 3 times a week. Your real frequency, not the one the app imposes.
onboarding.step2Body: Normal day: Run 5 km. Bad day: Walk 10 min, and it counts as done.
onboarding.step2Note: We measure consistency over the days that were due, not streaks.
